repo_url.description: Optional in mod.json; the registry supplies the source repository URL.

mod_dependencies.description: Required pak mods, validated against package_db. Preferred over the deprecated dependencies field; registry output also copies this list to dependencies for older clients.

plugin_dependencies.description: Required DLL plugins, validated against dll_db. The launcher requires explicit enablement and Unchained launch.

dependencies.description: Deprecated alias of mod_dependencies; accepted for backward compatibility. Both lists are combined on read, deduplicating repository/version pairs. Registry output emits the combined list under both names for older clients. Use mod_dependencies in new mod.json files.
